method: v12: phase N (traced, timestamped cont/stop per frame) gives the event frame count N with park/end CT verification; phase T (free-run) brackets the event duration in wall time from sparse timestamped polls, each followed by cont because a served read implicitly halts the core (DE-029) - the window [cont, read] is the running interval. drain_paired proves reply pairing first (DE-028). fps = N / D with a per-packet latency bound widening D; start/end samples retained with absolute epochs. No CT-rate baseline, no Lua console, no hardcoded prediction, no whole-battle extrapolation.
ct_datum: single 2-byte reads at 0x020160E8 (coherent across the cycle; v9)
